correctness.rationale: The word model h+v+2d=n, rank v+d and precisely the covers H→V, HH→D and D→VV were reconstructed from RESULT.md and verifier code. For every lower rank pair the integer-capacity source-to-upper flow saturates iff all subsets satisfy normalized matching (Hall/max-flow min-cut). The H/V order-reversing involution gives upper halves; on odd sizes the first-unmatched-H to V bijection supplies the equal-size central pair. Independent Python Dinic checked every lower-half comparison n=0..10; independently reconstructed C++ integer-flow verifier completed n=0..13, n=14..17, and n=18 in disjoint k=0..5,6,7..8 runs (largest exact flow 1837659219795). All capacities and tested totals fit int64. Finite exhaustive proof is limited to n<=18; no statement for n>=19.
